title: Summer job at the beach café
text:
SUMMER JOB – WAITERS WANTED
The Blue Wave Café on Sunset Beach needs three waiters from 1st July to 31st August.
You will take orders, serve food and drinks, and keep the tables clean. You need to be friendly and good with people. Speaking English is important, because many of our customers are tourists. A second language like French or German is a plus, but not necessary.
You don't need experience. We give all new staff two days of training before the season starts.
The hours are from 10 am to 6 pm, five days a week. You can choose your two free days. The pay is twelve euros an hour, and you get a free lunch every day you work.
You must be eighteen or older.
To apply, send an email with a short description of yourself to jobs@bluewave.com before 15th June. We will call you for an interview.

title: Room to rent
text:
ROOM TO RENT IN A SHARED FLAT
We are two young professionals looking for a third person to share our flat in the city centre. The room is large and sunny, with a big window, a double bed, a desk and a wardrobe.
The flat has a modern kitchen, a living room with a balcony and one bathroom. There is also a washing machine. We are five minutes on foot from the metro station and there are lots of shops and restaurants nearby.
The rent is 450 euros a month, including water and electricity. Internet costs an extra 15 euros.
We are quiet people and we both work during the day. We like cooking together at the weekend, but we also respect each other's privacy. Sorry, no smokers and no pets.
The room is available from 1st September. If you are interested, send us a message and come to see the flat.

title: Why I cycle to work
model: Cambridge A2 Key – Reading Part 3 (short article)
text:
Two years ago, I sold my car and bought a bike. My friends thought I was crazy, but it was one of the best decisions of my life.
I live eight kilometres from my office. By car, the journey took forty minutes because of the traffic. By bike, it takes about thirty minutes, and I never get stuck in traffic jams.
I also feel healthier. I lost six kilos in the first year and I sleep better at night. In the morning, I arrive at work full of energy.
Of course, there are some problems. When it rains, I arrive wet, so I always keep a dry shirt in my office. In winter, it is dark in the evening, so I bought good lights for my bike.
And the money! I don't pay for petrol or parking anymore. Last year I saved more than two thousand euros, and I spent some of it on a holiday in Italy.

title: Review: Casa Lola
text:
Last Friday, my husband and I had dinner at Casa Lola, the new Spanish restaurant on King Street. We booked a table for eight o'clock, but it was very busy and we waited twenty minutes before we could sit down.
The restaurant is small and warm, with old photos on the walls and soft music. The waiters were friendly, and our waiter, Pablo, explained every dish on the menu.
We ordered five tapas to share. The potatoes with spicy sauce and the garlic prawns were excellent. The cheese was good, but the chicken was a bit dry. For dessert, we had a delicious chocolate cake.
The bill was sixty euros for two people, with drinks. That's not cheap, but the food was fresh and the portions were big.
Would I go back? Yes, but next time I'll go on a weekday, when it's quieter.

title: Learn to cook Thai food!
text:
LEARN TO COOK THAI FOOD!
Do you love Thai food? Do you want to make it at home? Join our evening cooking course at the Community Centre.
The course has six classes, every Wednesday from 7 to 9 pm, starting on 5th October. In each class you will cook two dishes, like green curry, pad thai and mango sticky rice. At the end of the class, you eat what you cook!
Our teacher, Malee, grew up in Bangkok and worked as a chef for fifteen years. She explains everything step by step, so the course is perfect for beginners.
The price is 120 euros for the six classes. This includes all the food and a recipe book to take home. You only need to bring an apron.
There are only twelve places, so book soon! Call the Community Centre on 020 7946 0321 or visit our website.

title: Bus 24: changes to the route
text:
IMPORTANT: CHANGES TO BUS 24
From Monday 10th April to Friday 28th April, there will be roadworks on Bridge Street. During this time, bus 24 will not stop at the Bridge Street or the Town Hall stops.
The bus will go along River Road instead. There will be a temporary stop outside the swimming pool on River Road. It is about five minutes on foot from the Town Hall.
The journey will take about ten minutes longer than usual, so please leave home earlier.
On Sundays, bus 24 will run every thirty minutes instead of every twenty minutes.
All other buses are not changing.
We are sorry for any problems this may cause. For more information, download our free app or call 0800 555 2424. You can also ask our drivers.

title: Email: Thursday's meeting
text:
Hi everyone,
Just a quick email about Thursday's meeting with our new clients from Canada.
The meeting was at 10 am, but the clients' flight arrives late on Wednesday night, so we are moving it to 2 pm. It will be in the big meeting room on the third floor, not in my office.
Before the meeting, please read the report that I sent you on Monday. It's important that everyone knows the numbers from last year.
Laura, can you prepare the presentation? Tom, can you order sandwiches and coffee for twelve people? The clients are vegetarian, so please don't order any meat.
After the meeting, I'm taking the clients to dinner. If you would like to come, let me know by Wednesday so I can book a bigger table.
Thanks,
Daniel

title: Summer Music Festival
text:
SUMMER MUSIC FESTIVAL – CENTRAL PARK
Saturday 20th and Sunday 21st July
This year our free festival has more than twenty bands from all over the country. There is rock, pop, jazz and traditional music, so there is something for everyone.
The music starts at 2 pm and finishes at 11 pm on both days. The big stage is next to the lake, and there is a smaller stage for young bands near the main gate.
There is also a family area with games, face painting and a puppet show for children.
You can buy food and drinks from more than thirty stalls. You can bring your own food, but glass bottles are not allowed in the park.
There is no parking near the park during the festival, so please come by bus, by bike or on foot. Extra buses will run until midnight.
If it rains, the festival will continue, so bring a raincoat!

title: Volunteers needed at the animal shelter
text:
CAN YOU HELP OUR ANIMALS?
Happy Paws Animal Shelter is looking for volunteers. We have more than sixty dogs and cats, and we need help to look after them.
Volunteers walk the dogs, play with the cats, clean the rooms and help visitors who want to adopt a pet. You don't need to know a lot about animals. We will show you everything on your first day.
We need people especially at the weekend, from 9 am to 1 pm. You can come every week or just once or twice a month.
Volunteers must be at least sixteen. If you are younger, you can come with a parent.
Volunteering is not paid, but you will meet great people, get lots of exercise and make many animals very happy. It also looks good on your CV!
Interested? Fill in the form on our website or come and visit us at 14 Oak Lane.

title: Returns and refunds
text:
TECHZONE – RETURNS AND REFUNDS
Are you not happy with your purchase? Don't worry. You can return most products within 30 days and get your money back.
To get a refund, you need to bring the product, the box and your receipt. The product must be in perfect condition. If you don't have the receipt, we can give you a gift card for the same amount, but not cash.
Phones and tablets: you can return them within 14 days only, and they must not be damaged.
Headphones: for hygiene reasons, we can't take them back if you have opened the box.
If your product stops working, you don't need to return it. All our products have a two-year guarantee, so we will repair it for free.
Online orders: you can return them in any of our shops or by post. We pay for the post.
